scope: Independent static source review of immutable scalar projection, signed chart renderer and focused tests; actual qualification pending
checks: Two exact payload components are copied into fixed24/7 immutable scalar buckets; no sum, rate conversion or data path/clock ownership.

Setter/tooltip/accessibility paths retain QPointer and current-frame guards across deletion and direct reentry; immutable facts outlive source aliases/widgets.
Tests cover bounded facts, date labels, owned copies, signed extremes, rendered missing/zero/gap/isolated traces, nearest-bucket hover and callback lifetimes.
